== English errata comparison sources ==
Original, Decipher Glossary Version 2.0 (PDF page 48), and Players Committee Appendix A (PDF page 109) document three complete word states. Original power 2, ability 2, deploy 4, forfeit 3, destiny 1 and uniqueness are conserved. The Glossary replacement is documented separately; no matching full-card image is shown. Curly and straight apostrophe shapes are preserved literally, without inventing a punctuation state.

Reprints and Virtual editions remain outside these English original-card comparison columns.
